item.title: Vadh 2 Final Box Office Collections: Sanjay Mishra and Neena Gupta-led crime thriller set to wrap theatrical run at Rs 3.35 crore
item.description: Sanjay Mishra and Neena Gupta starrer crime thriller, Vadh 2, has almost exhausted its entire theatrical run at the box office. The Jaspal Singh Sandhu directorial debuted with Rs. 50 lakh on Day 1 and went on to collect around Rs. 3.05 crore in its opening week. Furthermore, the movie witnessed a massive drop in the second week, when it minted just Rs. 25 lakh. Since then, it only could add around Rs. 5 lakh more to the tally, bringing its entire cume to Rs. 3.35 crore nett (Rs. 4 crore gross)
